name: composepwa-tooling
description: Formatter & linter tooling for the ComposePWA repository (web assets). This file pins the tools; how each one is invoked lives in .github/workflows/lint.yml and specs.yml.

scripts.format: biome check --write && prettier --write plugin/src/main/resources "test-projects/web-app/*.html" && eslint --fix plugin/src/main/resources
